about_the_game:
Pick up the Pieces,

You hear a loud crash from the other room. A vase has fallen off the shelf. Mr Stitches' tail sweeps back and forth. Time to get to work.

Take a Breath, Wait a moment,

You lay the pieces out in front of you. There's a mixture of shapes, colours and patterns. You shake your head. You can't see it. Mr Stitches leaps down and brushes against your arm. You smile and take a deep breath. A fresh shadow appears before you.

Trust Mr Stitches.

You begin thoughtfully rotating and placing the pieces. You choose the biggest pieces first and start from the corners. Remember to alternate colours. Some of the shapes fit together perfectly. But you get stuck. Mr Stitches purrs. He gives you a clue. You place the final piece. He takes care of the rest. The shadows dance around you both.

He's The Kintsugi Cat, after all.

KEY FEATURES:

  • Four seasonally themed stages;

  • 64 unique, hand crafted levels that gradually increase in complexity;

  • Random Level Selector;

  • Hand drawn, minimalist background art and calming music;

  • Simple, intuitive controls optimised for Mouse or Touchpad;

  • Adjustable sound settings;

  • Hint available in every level.

short_description: Piece together alternating coloured shards of broken pottery into new designs, then watch as they're fixed together with gold; in this Kintsugi-themed, Japanese minimalism inspired, 2.5D jigsaw puzzle game.
